stops.note: Hormel Foods of Austin, Minnesota, named its canned pork in 1937 after a naming contest won by actor Ken Daigneau; Lend-Lease shipped it to Britain and the USSR in World War II
Monty Python's 1970 sketch set in a café where every dish comes with Spam, drowned out by Vikings singing 'Spam, Spam, Spam'
online users borrowed the sketch for floods of repeated messages; a 1994 Usenet mass advertisement by the lawyers Canter and Siegel made it notorious

current_meaning: unwanted bulk messages sent online; a brand of canned meat
